classification.difficultyReason: Infer the full width and height from the labelled segments, choose a rectangular split for the L-shape, and translate the boundary and component areas into simplified algebraic sums.

content.prompt: For the shaded $L$-shaped region below, find:

spec.description: A lower horizontal arm extends left from a vertical arm on the right. Four right-angle markers retain their source positions: the upper-left corner of the lower arm, the inner notch, the bottom-left corner and the bottom-right corner. The shared figure remains left-aligned beneath the stem and above both response parts.
spec.mathematics: The top edge is x cm, the inner horizontal edge is 2x cm, and the inner and outer-left vertical edges are each 3 cm. The unlabelled bottom and outer-right edges are therefore 3x cm and 6 cm. Coordinates express the source orientation and illustrative proportions, not an additional numerical value for x. Light blue shading identifies the requested region; ordinary outlines, labels and angle markers are black.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the four source dimension labels and four right-angle markers are visible. Inferred dimensions, decompositions and answers are solution-only.

children.label: a
children.prompt: the perimeter of the shaded region.

answer.worked:
The bottom edge is $(2x+x)=3x$ cm and the right edge is $(3+3)=6$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}P&=x+3+2x+3+3x+6\\P&=(6x+12)\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: the area of the shaded region.

answer.short: $12x\text{ cm}^2$; add the two rectangle areas, $3(3x)+3x$.
answer.worked:
Split horizontally at the notch: the lower rectangle is $3x$ cm by $3$ cm, and the upper rectangle is $x$ cm by $3$ cm. Add their areas.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(3x)\times3+x\times3\\A&=9x+3x\\A&=12x\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
